Office Hours | Software Engineer, Senior/Staff Software Engineer | SF, NYC, or Remote (US) | https://officehours.com

We help experts earn meaningful income, often five figures a year, by sharing what they already know through Zoom calls, surveys, and AI interviews.

Team: We’re a small, senior team that values quality, simplicity, curiosity, and collaboration. If you’re excited about building thoughtful user experiences and high-quality software, reach out!

Product: On the surface, the product looks simple: search, match, connect, and pay. Under the hood, we're tackling interesting engineering challenges.

- Search & Discovery: Surface the right experts instantly from structured and unstructured queries - Data & Recommendations: Build a knowledge graph from scratch to power better insights - Workflow Automation: Design and streamline multi-step workflows with AI - Performance & Scaling: Ensure speed, reliability, and scalability as we grow

Open roles:

- Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Full Stack: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/office-hours/f9e9f476-100b-4d86-b36... - Software Engineer, Full Stack: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/office-hours/664c0299-27c5-4550-91e... - Senior Product Designer: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/office-hours/d4ad4cb1-8ccd-49a9-b97...
